welcome.title: Welcome to UA Arena
welcome.kicker: Union Arena lists, titles, and table talk

announcements.title: Format pulse
announcements.body: English events are single-title Standard: 50 cards, usually one IP. Names showing up most on public lists right now: Solo Leveling - Sung Jinwoo, Evangelion - Rei Ayanami, Evangelion - Evangelion Test Type-01 Pseudo DMS Phase, Rurouni Kenshin - Kaoru Kamiya.

announcements.title: Restricted in constructed
announcements.body: Bandai limited UE15BT/EVA-1-051, UE15BT/EVA-1-063 to one copy each. This site flags lists that still play more than one.

announcements.title: How lists land here
announcements.body: Consensus 50s come from TCG Contender Standard snapshots. Official top-placing recipes and public YouTube lists sit next to them. The board refreshes with the weekly site ingest.

announcements.title: Share a 50
announcements.body: Paste `NxSET/CODE` lines in the matching anime or manga thread. Copy on any list page dumps that format. One thread per title: Solo Leveling, Yu Yu Hakusho, Evangelion, and the rest.
